body:
## What it does

Starts from proven performers rather than everything you have posted, picks the strong hooks, formats 9:16 with captions, and ships in weekday batches. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @farzyness shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
